description: Original synthetic inquiries and invented company conditions. No private mail, company seed or string-redacted real inquiry is included.

cases.title: New custom range: answer known terms, ask two useful questions
cases.inquiry:
Hello,
We are planning a weatherproof cycling jacket and a commuter vest using our own designs, rather than selecting standard catalog styles. Can you develop these categories? What is your usual MOQ, sample development time and production lead time? We have not settled the initial launch quantity or color allocation yet.
Thank you.

company_context.statement: We develop and manufacture custom cycling jackets and commuter vests. This confirms the categories only, not any particular material performance or certification.
Our usual MOQ baseline is 240 pcs. No per-style or per-color minimum is authorized; allocation needs project review.
company_context.scope: Normal bulk inquiries; pcs; general baseline

company_context.statement: Normal sample development takes 18 business days after receipt of the sample fee, once materials are available. The project timeline needs material availability confirmation.
company_context.scope: Sample development; business days; after fee receipt and material availability

company_context.statement: Normal production takes 70-95 calendar days after both deposit receipt and sample approval, subject to project material availability and capacity confirmation.
company_context.scope: Bulk production; calendar days; both deposit and sample approval; material/capacity checks

cases.business_brief: Answer category fit, the general MOQ baseline, normal sample timing and normal production timing with their applicable conditions. Ask which style to develop first and for any available design material; ask the estimated first production quantity and its style/color allocation. Own designs are already known, so do not ask standard versus custom. Next move: review the priority design and material route, then prepare the sample-cost basis and conditional preliminary costing. Do not offer stock fabrics, certification or a firm project quotation.

required_answers: 240 pcs general MOQ without invented basis
18 business days after sample fee and available materials
70-95 calendar days after both deposit and sample approval, with project checks
necessary_questions: Priority style and available design material
Estimated initial production quantity and style/color allocation
gold.next_move: Priority design/material assessment leading to sample-cost basis and conditional preliminary costing
forbidden: Firm price/date, certification or stock claims

cases.title: Quote tiers are not an order; branded sourcing is unverified
cases.inquiry:
Hello,
We are exploring a lightweight rain jacket and stretch riding trousers. Please assess prices at 120, 360 and 720 pcs for each product; these are comparison tiers, not order quantities. The jacket target is 15K waterproofness and 10K breathability, with a PFAS-free finish and StormMesh-branded fabric. Please explain your normal MOQ and production time, and whether you can support development.
Thanks.

company_context.statement: We develop rain jackets and stretch riding trousers. Material sourcing, performance and branded-material access must be checked with suppliers before project confirmation.
company_context.scope: Rain jackets and stretch riding trousers; category experience only

company_context.statement: Our usual MOQ baseline is 240 pcs. No per-style or per-color minimum is authorized. Lower-volume exceptions require internal review, not automatic acceptance.
company_context.scope: Normal bulk inquiries; pcs; exceptions require review

company_context.statement: Normal production takes 70-95 calendar days after both deposit receipt and sample approval, subject to project material availability and capacity confirmation.
company_context.scope: Bulk production; calendar days; both deposit and sample approval; material/capacity checks

cases.business_brief: Answer the authorized category fit, normal general MOQ and conditional production time. Primary advance: verify the material/technical route and branded supply access; parallel advance: conditional rough costing at the stated comparison tiers, subject to that verification and internal review of the lower tier. Ask the priority product and available design; ask which specified branded materials must be original and which may use equivalent alternatives. Do not re-ask the performance targets or quote quantities. Do not describe the tiers as an order, promise a MOQ exception, or claim authorized branded sourcing or achieved performance.

necessary_questions: Original branded material versus acceptable equivalent
gold.next_move: Material/sourcing verification with parallel conditional rough costing of comparison tiers

cases.title: One prototype is known; an existing source is unread
cases.inquiry:
Hello,
We want ONE prototype of a custom trail overshirt, using a new pattern rather than enlarging an existing style. Our material targets are 12K waterproofness and 8K breathability. We have attached shape-notes.pdf with our fit direction. Please tell us how you would start, the prototype cost and normal development time, and whether you can ship the prototype to Finland. Bulk production would be considered only after prototype approval.
Thank you.

company_context.statement: We have experience developing custom outerwear patterns and seam-taped outerwear prototypes. This does not confirm current materials achieve the customer's performance targets.
company_context.scope: Outerwear prototype experience; current materials/performance not confirmed

company_context.statement: Normal sample development takes 18 business days after receipt of the sample fee, once materials are available. The project timeline needs material availability confirmation.
company_context.scope: Sample development; business days; after fee receipt and material availability

company_context.statement: We can arrange prototype shipment to Finland. Freight cost and transit time for this project are not confirmed.
company_context.scope: Prototype shipment to Finland only; no freight/transit commitment

cases.business_brief: Begin assessing the written specifications now; review the existing shape-notes before making fit assumptions or asking for information they may contain. Verify available material options and relevant test evidence with suppliers. Conditional prototype costing can proceed in parallel, dependent on the route; no firm prototype price is currently authorized. Answer the normal 18-business-day development reference with fee/material conditions and authorized Finland shipment. One prototype is already known: never ask sample quantity or request the already-referenced file again. If useful, ask the expected first production quantity after prototype approval, expressly without making it a prerequisite to current prototype assessment. The 12K/8K figures stay customer targets, and bulk interest stays conditional interest.

required_answers: Prototype assessment based on written spec and pending fit-source review
18 business days after fee with available-material condition
Price and firm project timing require route/material verification
necessary_questions: Optional expected initial production quantity after prototype approval; not a prototype blocker
gold.next_move: Review existing fit source and verify materials, with conditional prototype costing in parallel
forbidden: Unread attachment treated as read or missing
Future production quantity blocks prototype assessment
